compute_weighted_percentile: compute the weighted percentile of an array using sample weights and a specified percentile rank
calculate_weighted_median: calculate the weighted median of a 1D or 2D array with sample weights using the inverted_cdf method
compute_symmetrical_weighted_percentile: compute symmetrical weighted percentiles using the averaged_inverted_cdf method with unit weights
calculate_weighted_percentiles_2d: calculate weighted percentiles across columns of a 2D array handling NaN values column-isolated
compute_multiple_weighted_percentiles: compute multiple weighted percentiles at once by passing a 1D array of percentile ranks
